findings.description: Victoriana Vasquez married Jose Cleofas Gutierrez on 9 January 1875 in Degollado, Jalisco, Mexico, according to a marriage index entry that spells her surname Vazquez and names no parents.
supporting_sources: Mexico, Marriages, 1570-1950 — marriage entry for Jose Cleofas Gutierrez and Victoriana Vazquez, 9 Jan 1875
